title: [finding] Free-plan environment list: the primary 「新建环境」 stand-in opens a paywall dialog from EnvironmentListToolbar's upgrade_for_development branch; cloud metadata cannot reach it
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2775 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2784, its "Not in this PR" section). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

On a free-plan organization's environment list, the only primary button is 「新建环境」. Clicking it opens 「开发环境是付费功能……」 with 「关闭 / 升级套餐」 (staging screenshot `05-new-environment-paywall.jpg` on cloud branch `design-assets/cloud-console-2026-10`, commit `fdd422db`). The maintainer accepted, with 「同意」, that no primary button opens a paywall dialog (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 3 → objectstack-ai/cloud#2775).

## Evidence (objectui at cloud's pin `d758f2f2`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/environment/EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx`, `upgrade_for_development` branch: it renders a primary `Button` (`data-testid="environment-add-upgrade"`) whose `onClick` opens `upgradeDialogSpec()` (`entitlements.ts`).
- The `?runAction=create_environment` deep-link effect opens the same dialog.
- The toolbar filters on `actionRendersAt` and the capability gate, never on `visible`, so no cloud metadata change reaches it. The cloud half (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2784) moved every cloud-owned paid point to an inline mark; this one is objectui's.

## Wanted

An outline, locked mark 「开发环境 · 团队版起」 with a lock icon, linking to the entitlement summary's `upgradeUrl`. No dialog. i18n in objectui's locales. The cloud wording for the same tier is 「团队版起」 (the zh bundle's plan label, objectstack-ai/cloud#2612).

## Delivery note

Cloud's objectui-alone pin bumps stop at `82bb1d5842` until cloud's framework pin moves to v18 (triage pin-pair rule on objectstack-ai/cloud#2709, `6116951023`). A fix merged after that point reaches cloud with that move.

Dedupe: searched open objectui issues for `EnvironmentListToolbar`, `upgrade_for_development`, `environment-add-upgrade` and `upgradeDialogSpec`: none.
